name: carbon-badge-record
description: Records a job's duration and real CPU/memory into an artifact name.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --minify --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/index.mjs && esbuild src/post.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --minify --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/post/index.mjs
